segments.text: CHriſt riſing agayne from the dead, nowe dieth not. Death from hence furth hath no power vpon hym. For in that he dyed, he dyed but once to put awaye ſinne: but in that he liueth he liueth vnto God. And ſo lykewyſe, counte youre ſelues dead vnto ſynne, but lyuyng vnto God in Chriſte Ieſus our Lorde. Alleluya Alleluya.

CHriſte is riſen agayne, the fyrſte fruytes of them that ſlepe: for ſeyng that by man came deathe, by man alſo commeth the reſurreccion of the dead: For as by Adam al men do dye, ſo by Chriſte all menne ſhalbe reſtored to lyfe. Alleluya.

The Prieſt.
¶Shewe forth to all nacions the glory of God.

The Aunſwere.
¶And among all people his wonderful workes.

Let vs praye.
O God, who for our redēpcion diddeſt geue thine onely begotten ſonne to the death of the croſſe: & by his gloryous reſurreccion haſt delyuered vs from the power of our enemye: Graunte vs ſo to dye dayly frō ſinne, that we may euermore liue with him in the ioye of his reſurreccion: through theſame Chriſt our Lorde. Amen.
